# RoachPet v1.0.0

RoachPet is a portable Windows desktop pet with animated cockroaches that roam your screen.

## Download

Extract `RoachPet-1.0.0-windows-x64-portable.zip` and run `RoachPet.exe`. No installation is required.

Windows WebView2 Runtime must already be installed and is not included.

## Included

- Smooth roaming with idle pauses, bursts, edge bouncing, and click-to-flee
- 1–10 cockroaches with Chinese settings
- System tray controls and Cantonese hover dialogue

No automatic updates are included.
